crossRefs.note: Turn to me, and have mercy on me, for I am desolate and afflicted.
The troubles of my heart are enlarged. Oh bring me out of my distresses.
Therefore you shall make images of your tumors and images of your mice that mar the land; and you shall give glory to…
Let him take his rod away from me. Let his terror not make me afraid;
withdraw your hand far from me, and don’t let your terror make me afraid.
There is no soundness in my flesh because of your indignation, neither is there any health in my bones because of my…
For my iniquities have gone over my head. As a heavy burden, they are too heavy for me.
Will you even annul my judgment? Will you condemn me, that you may be justified?

translations.web: Remove your scourge away from me. I am overcome by the blow of your hand.
translations.bsb: Remove Your scourge from me; I am perishing by the force of Your hand.
translations.kjv: Remove thy stroke away from me: I am consumed by the blow of thine hand.
translations.asv: Remove thy stroke away from me: I am consumed by the blow of thy hand.
